personality.speech_style: folksy, conversational, uses endearments like 'dearie' and 'love'

general: Runs The Rusty Tankard inn for 20 years
Knows everyone in Arden and their business
Has heard worrying rumors about the old cemetery
local_lore: The Davos family has protected Arden for generations
The chapel was built by Lord Davos after he defeated something evil long ago

shop.sell_dialogue: What can I get you, dearie?
shop.insufficient_funds_dialogue: Oh dearie, looks like you're a bit short there.

dialogue.greeting: Well now, look what the wind blew in! Welcome to the Rusty Tankard. What can I get for you?
dialogue.farewell: Safe travels, dearie. Come back soon!
dialogue.hostile_greeting: I don't serve your kind here. Move along.

personality.speech_style: formal but kind, occasionally references scripture, speaks with measured concern

general: Serves as the town's priest for 15 years
Expert on local religious history and the legend of Davos
Has felt a dark presence growing at the cemetery
The holy wards on the crypt have been weakening
local_lore: Lord Davos defeated the devil Durgon two hundred years ago
Davos's holy symbol is said to still rest in his tomb
The crypt was sealed with divine wards that have weakened over time
Unholy chanting has been heard from the cemetery at night

shop.sell_dialogue: The church has a few blessed items that might aid righteous travelers.
shop.insufficient_funds_dialogue: I wish I could help more, but the church has its own needs.

dialogue.greeting: Blessings upon you, travelers. I am Father Aldric. How may I serve you?
dialogue.farewell: May the Light guide your path and shield you from darkness.
dialogue.hostile_greeting: Leave this holy place at once.

guard_captain_roderick.name: Captain Roderick
guard_captain_roderick.display_name: Captain Roderick of the Town Guard

personality.speech_style: clipped and military, gets to the point, distrustful of strangers

general: Commands the small town guard of Arden
Has noticed increased undead activity near the cemetery
Concerned about protecting the town with limited resources
Reports to the mayor but makes tactical decisions independently
local_lore: The guard has been stretched thin lately
Several travelers have gone missing on the roads
Something is disturbing the old burial grounds

dialogue.greeting: Halt. State your business in Arden.
dialogue.farewell: Keep your weapons sheathed in town. Move along.
dialogue.hostile_greeting: You're not welcome here. Leave now or face the consequences.

personality.speech_style: formal and aristocratic, speaks slowly and deliberately, voice weakened by age

general: Last living heir of the Davos bloodline
Too old and frail to investigate the crypt himself
Deeply troubled by the disturbances at the family crypt
Has offered a reward for those who can put his ancestors to rest
local_lore: His ancestor, the original Lord Davos, was a mighty cleric who defeated the devil Durgon
The family has protected Arden for generations
The skull of his ancestor holds great significance to the family
Possesses a jar of blessed ointment passed down through generations

dialogue.greeting: Ah... visitors. Forgive me if I do not rise. These old bones do not cooperate as they once did. What brings you to Davos Manor?
dialogue.farewell: Go with the blessing of House Davos. May you fare better than my ancestors.
dialogue.hostile_greeting: I have no quarrel with you. Please... leave an old man in peace.

skull_of_davos.dialogue: My ancestor's skull... you found it. You have done House Davos a great service. Please, take this ointment - it has been in my family for generations, blessed by my ancestor himself. Use it well.

personality.speech_style: businesslike but friendly, enjoys haggling, knows the value of everything

general: Runs the general store in Arden for 12 years
Has connections with merchants from larger cities
Knows what gear sells and what sits on shelves
local_lore: Trade has been slow lately with the troubles
Adventurers have been buying more weapons and healing supplies

shop.sell_dialogue: Looking to buy? I've got quality goods at fair prices.
shop.insufficient_funds_dialogue: Hmm, looks like your purse is a bit light. Come back when you've got the coin.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to Gareth's Goods! Best supplies in Arden - well, the only supplies in Arden, but still the best. What can I get you?
dialogue.farewell: Safe travels! Come back when you need to restock.
dialogue.hostile_greeting: I don't do business with troublemakers. Out.
